security.checkAdvice.accounts.empty_pass: Set a password or lock the listed accounts (passwd -l <account>).
security.checkAdvice.accounts.pass_max_d: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS to 365 or less in /etc/login.defs (applies to new passwords).
security.checkAdvice.accounts.uid0: Another account with UID 0 has full control of the server. Remove it or change its UID.
security.checkAdvice.audit.auditd: Install and turn on auditd to record sensitive access and changes.
security.checkAdvice.files.shadow_permis: The file holds the password hashes: chown root:shadow /etc/shadow and chmod 640 /etc/shadow.
security.checkAdvice.firewall.active: Turn on a host firewall (nftables, ufw or firewalld) or Cyber Security Protection, allowing only the ports you need.
security.checkAdvice.mac.auto_install: Turn on "Install macOS updates" in Software Update.
security.checkAdvice.mac.auto_login: Turn off automatic login in System Settings > Users & Groups.
security.checkAdvice.mac.filevault: Turn on FileVault in System Settings > Privacy & Security to encrypt the disk.
security.checkAdvice.mac.firewall: Turn on the firewall in System Settings > Network > Firewall.
security.checkAdvice.mac.firewall_stealt: Turn on stealth mode in the firewall options so the Mac does not answer network probes.
security.checkAdvice.mac.gatekeeper: Turn Gatekeeper back on (sudo spctl --master-enable) so only signed and checked apps open.
security.checkAdvice.mac.guest_account: Turn off the guest user in System Settings > Users & Groups.
security.checkAdvice.mac.screen_sharing: Turn off Screen Sharing in System Settings > General > Sharing when it is not used.
security.checkAdvice.mac.security_update: Turn on automatic installation of security responses and system files in Software Update.
security.checkAdvice.mac.sip: Turn SIP back on from recovery mode (csrutil enable) and restart the Mac.
security.checkAdvice.mac.ssh_password_au: With Remote Login on, use keys and set PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d.
security.checkAdvice.mac.update_check: Turn on "Check for updates" in System Settings > General > Software Update.
security.checkAdvice.mac.updates_pending: Install the listed updates in System Settings > General > Software Update.
security.checkAdvice.ssh.max_auth_tries: Set MaxAuthTries to 4 or less in sshd_config.
security.checkAdvice.ssh.password_auth: Use SSH keys and set PasswordAuthentication no. Passwords exposed to the internet face brute force attacks all the time.
security.checkTitle.ssh.root_login: SSH root login with a password
security.checkAdvice.ssh.root_login: Set PermitRootLogin no (or prohibit-password) in sshd_config and restart SSH. Sign in as a regular user and use sudo.
security.checkAdvice.ssh.x11_forwarding: Set X11Forwarding no unless you use remote graphical applications.
security.checkAdvice.sysctl.aslr: Set kernel.randomize_va_space = 2 in /etc/sysctl.d/ and apply with sysctl --system.
security.checkAdvice.sysctl.dmesg_restri: Set kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1 so only root reads the kernel log.
security.checkAdvice.sysctl.send_redirec: On a server that is not a router, set net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0.
security.checkAdvice.sysctl.suid_dumpabl: Set fs.suid_dumpable = 0 so privileged programs do not write their memory to disk.
security.checkAdvice.time.sync: Turn on chrony or systemd-timesyncd. Logs and certificates depend on the right time.
security.checkAdvice.win.autorun_disable: Turn off AutoRun for every drive (NoDriveTypeAutoRun = 255).
security.checkAdvice.win.firewall_profil: Turn on Windows Firewall for the Domain, Private and Public profiles.
security.checkAdvice.win.guest_disabled: Turn off the Guest account (Disable-LocalUser -Name Guest).
security.checkAdvice.win.llmnr_disabled: Turn off multicast name resolution (policy "Turn off multicast name resolution").
security.checkAdvice.win.lockout_thresho: Set the account lockout threshold to 1-5 invalid attempts.
security.checkAdvice.win.lsa_protection: Turn on LSA protection (RunAsPPL = 1) to make credential theft from memory harder.
security.checkAdvice.win.password_comple: Turn on "Password must meet complexity requirements" in the security policy.
security.checkAdvice.win.password_length: Set the minimum password length to 14 characters in the local or domain security policy.
security.checkAdvice.win.rdp_nla: Require Network Level Authentication (NLA) in the Remote Desktop settings.
security.checkAdvice.win.smb1_disabled: Turn off SMBv1 (Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false). WannaCry spread through it.
security.checkAdvice.win.smb_signing: Require signing on the SMB server (Set-SmbServerConfiguration -RequireSecuritySignature $true).
security.checkAdvice.win.tls10_disabled: Turn off server TLS 1.0 in SCHANNEL (Enabled = 0) after confirming the clients use TLS 1.2.
security.checkAdvice.win.update_service: Do not disable the Windows Update service (wuauserv); security updates depend on it.
security.checkAdvice.win.wdigest_disable: Set UseLogonCredential = 0: with WDigest on the password stays readable in memory.
